A '''talking tree''' living on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon]] of [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]], where he had put down roots near the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[City/Legends|settlement]] of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] by [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. The talking tree was well-disposed to the Ewoks neighbors. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Bright Tree's [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]] was tasked by her [[Parent/Legends|father]], [[Chief/Legends|Chief]] [[Chirpa/Legends|Chirpa]], with throwing a party in honor of a visiting dignitary known as Prince [[Delby]]. To help Kintaka with the preparations, the Ewok [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]] led the [[Bordok/Legends|bordok]] [[Baga]] throughout the forest and distributed posters&mdash;large leaves with information about the event scribbled onto them&mdash;from Baga's saddlebags. Warrick affixed one announcements to the face of the talking tree who lived in the vicinity. With eyes and mouth closed, the sentient being resembled a mundane tree. The talking tree stirred, removed the poster, and responded favorably to the invitation to the party.<ref name="PE">{{Ewoks|Party Ewok}}</ref>
